Bakukyuu Renpatsu!! Super B-Daman - Geki.name: Bakukyuu Renpatsu!! Super B-Daman Gekitan! Rising Valkyrie!
Bakukyuu Renpatsu!! Super B-Daman - Geki.summary: Bakukyuu Renpatsu!! Super B-Daman Gekitan! Rising Valkyrie! is a Japanese only Game Boy Color game.

Beatmania GB 2 - Gotcha Mix.name: Beatmania GB Gotcha Mix 2
Beatmania GB 2 - Gotcha Mix.summary: Beatmania GB Gotcha Mix 2 is a videogame launched for Game Boy Color. It has 25 songs and it's the last portable videogame for beatmania franchise, and it's the only one from the trilogy to have "Duet" charts, which two players are needed to play this level via Game Boy link cable, two GBC's, and two copies of the same game.

Dance Dance Revolution GB.name: Dance Dance Revolution GB
Dance Dance Revolution GB.summary: Dance Dance Revolution GB was the start of a DDR series for the Game Color. Instead of the usual dance pads, it came with a miniature finger pad that could be strapped onto the handheld.
